options.text: Catalog metadata (title info, episodes, multi-language localization, region-specific licensing flags, rich descriptors mood/theme). Storage: Cassandra master data по title_id + Elasticsearch search index (full-text, fuzzy typos, faceted filters genre/year/language/rating, geo-restrictions per country, per-language analyzers russian/english/japanese) + EVCache hot для most-accessed titles. GraphQL Gateway: Federated GraphQL (Apollo Federation / Netflix Studio Edge), каждый сервис exposes schema fragment, client requests { title { name, recommendations { ... } } } — gateway orchestrates, заменяет REST для mobile/Web, built-in batching reduces round trips. Caching per-query в EVCache TTL 5min, invalidation через pub/sub when title metadata updated.

sections.explanation: Catalog service хранит metadata всех Netflix titles: title info (name, year, genre, cast, director, description), episode metadata для сериалов, multi-language localization (translations, subtitles), region-specific licensing flags (какой контент available в каком регионе), rich descriptors (mood, theme, era — используется в recommendation). Storage tier: master data в Cassandra (partition по title_id, легко lookup по ID, eventual consistency acceptable), search index в Elasticsearch (full-text + filters + facets), hot cache в EVCache (most-accessed titles типа top 1000 — в RAM). Elasticsearch index: per-language analyzers (russian, english, japanese — разные tokenization, stemming, stopwords), fuzzy matching для typos, faceted filters (genre, year, language, rating, geo-restrictions filter by user country). GraphQL Gateway — Federated GraphQL (Apollo Federation или внутренний Netflix Studio Edge): каждый microservice exposes свой schema fragment, client делает single GraphQL query `{ title { name, recommendations { ... }, episodes { ... } } }`, gateway orchestrates calls к multiple services. Заменяет REST для mobile + Web clients, built-in batching reduces round trips. Caching: per-query cache в EVCache с TTL 5 minutes (catalog data rarely changes), invalidation через pub/sub когда title metadata updated.
sections.example: Mobile app делает GraphQL query «дай title Stranger Things + episodes + similar titles» — gateway parallel calls Catalog Service (metadata), Episode Service (список), Recommendation Service (similar), aggregates, кеширует в EVCache на 5 min.
sections.when_to_apply: GraphQL Federation подходит для frontend с complex aggregation needs; Elasticsearch — стандарт для search/filters/facets; EVCache — для high-read hot metadata.
sections.edge_cases: GraphQL N+1 problem требует DataLoader pattern для batching; новый title не сразу в Elasticsearch (indexing delay seconds-minutes).
sections.related: Q14 recommendation; Q18 architecture.

options.label: B
options.text: Catalog service использует только MySQL и REST API; Elasticsearch и GraphQL не нужны для metadata.

sections.what_actually: MySQL не масштабируется на 270M users × 10K titles × full-text search + facets. Netflix использует Cassandra + Elasticsearch + GraphQL.
sections.source_of_confusion: Применение legacy stack для consumer-scale service.
sections.if_it_were_true: Search latency был бы 1-2s вместо <200ms; aggregation для GraphQL pattern был бы невозможен.
sections.how_it_should_be: Cassandra (master) + Elasticsearch (search) + EVCache (hot) + GraphQL gateway для frontend.

options.label: C
options.text: Catalog service полностью in-memory без persistent storage — данные пересоздаются при перезапуске.

sections.what_actually: Catalog — source of truth для всего контента, terabytes metadata. In-memory only невозможно сохранить и restart означал бы потерю данных.
sections.source_of_confusion: Перенос caching strategy на authoritative storage.
sections.if_it_were_true: Любой restart означал бы потерю всех metadata; пересоздание заняло бы дни.
sections.how_it_should_be: Persistent storage (Cassandra) + cache (EVCache) поверх.

options.label: D
options.text: GraphQL Federation не используется в Netflix; они используют только REST с custom URL versioning.

sections.what_actually: Netflix Studio Edge — internal GraphQL Federation platform, актвно используется для mobile + Web. Документировано в Netflix Tech Blog.
sections.source_of_confusion: Незнание Netflix-published architecture changes (2018+).
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix Tech Blog не публиковал бы статьи про GraphQL adoption.
sections.how_it_should_be: GraphQL Federation для frontend aggregation, REST для service-to-service.

blocks.question_text: Как Netflix реализует continue watching с синхронизацией между устройствами через Cassandra + Kafka?

options.label: A
options.text: Continue watching хранится только локально на каждом устройстве; нет cross-device sync, user должен помнить позицию вручную.

sections.what_actually: Cross-device sync — главная feature continue watching: user смотрит S1E5 на phone до 23:45 → открывает TV → продолжается с 23:45. Без backend storage это невозможно.
sections.source_of_confusion: Игнорирование multi-device use case Netflix.
sections.if_it_were_true: Phone → TV transition был бы невозможен; user терял бы позицию каждый раз.
sections.how_it_should_be: Backend Cassandra storage + Kafka events + multi-device sync.

options.label: B
options.text: Storage в Cassandra: CREATE TABLE watch_progress (user_id uuid, title_id uuid, position_ms bigint, updated_at timestamp, device_id text, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, title_id)) — partition by user_id (все progress one user — one node), cluster by title_id, eventual consistency LOCAL_QUORUM acceptable. Update flow: client сообщает position каждые 30s (или на pause/seek) → Watch Service write Cassandra + emit Kafka event → consumed by analytics pipeline, recommendation feature store, multi-device sync. Sync: Phone updates каждые 30s → TV opens → queries Cassandra → resumes from saved position, latency 5-10s cross-region (eventual). Last-write-wins для two devices simultaneously. Volume: 200M DAU × 4h × 1/30s = ~27K updates/sec sustained.

sections.explanation: Continue watching solves classic multi-device sync problem. Storage в Cassandra schema partition by user_id (все progress одного user-а localized в одном node — fast lookup), cluster by title_id, position_ms сохраняет позицию в миллисекундах. Cassandra eventual consistency с LOCAL_QUORUM acceptable — небольшое запаздывание sync (5-10s cross-region) приемлемо для UX. Update flow: client (phone, TV, web) сообщает position каждые 30 sec (или на pause/seek/close) → Watch Service делает write в Cassandra + emit Kafka event → event consumed by parallel pipelines: analytics (Iceberg для batch), recommendation feature store (для real-time updates), multi-device sync service. Sync: Phone updates каждые 30s → user закрывает phone → TV открывает Netflix app → Watch Service queries Cassandra LOCAL_QUORUM → resumes from saved position. Latency 5-10s acceptable для cross-region replication. Edge case: two devices simultaneously (например phone и TV одновременно) → last-write-wins (latest position wins). Offline progress (Q27) — buffered locally на client, synced when reconnect. Volume: 200M DAU × 4 hours/day × 1 update/30 sec = ~96M updates/hour, ~27K/sec sustained — Cassandra cluster sized accordingly.
sections.example: User смотрит Stranger Things S1E5 на phone до 23:45 в метро → закрывает Netflix → дома открывает Apple TV → Netflix sees recent watch_progress в Cassandra, начинает с 23:45 автоматически. Total latency восстановления — секунды.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой multi-device VOD/audio service нуждается в таком pattern; pattern также применим для game save states, document collaboration.
sections.edge_cases: Cross-region delay 30+ sec возможен при peak load — user может увидеть старую позицию пока replication догонит; offline-on watch progress буферизуется и батчем синхронизируется при reconnect.
sections.related: Q21 catalog; Q27 downloads; Q24 multi-region.

options.label: C
options.text: Cassandra partition by title_id (не user_id) — каждый title содержит все user-позиции в одном partition.

sections.what_actually: Partition by title_id создал бы hot partitions для популярных titles (millions users → one partition). Netflix partitions by user_id для distribution и быстрого user-specific lookup.
sections.source_of_confusion: Незнание Cassandra partition key best practices.
sections.if_it_were_true: Stranger Things partition содержал бы 100M+ rows → hot partition, Cassandra cluster degradation.
sections.how_it_should_be: Partition by user_id, cluster by title_id для скорости user-specific queries.

options.label: D
options.text: Watch progress хранится только в Kafka topics без Cassandra; consumers читают всю historical Kafka для restoration.

sections.what_actually: Kafka — append-only log, не подходит для random-access by user_id. Cassandra нужна как primary storage; Kafka — event stream для async consumers.
sections.source_of_confusion: Перенос event sourcing pattern на чистый Kafka-as-DB.
sections.if_it_were_true: TV открывает Netflix → должна re-read весь Kafka log за месяцы — невозможно в realtime.
sections.how_it_should_be: Cassandra primary store + Kafka events для async pipelines.

blocks.question_text: Что такое Chaos Engineering у Netflix и какие инструменты входят в Simian Army?

options.label: A
options.text: Chaos Engineering — это синтетический load testing в staging; в production Netflix никогда не вводит failures.

sections.what_actually: Netflix pioneered chaos в production: Chaos Monkey terminate real instances в business hours. Staging-only chaos не выявляет real-world failure modes.
sections.source_of_confusion: Безопасный «staging-only» подход вместо radical Netflix philosophy.
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix не публиковал бы Chaos Monkey/Kong и не имел бы 99.99% uptime.
sections.how_it_should_be: Chaos в production = пресечь real failures, validate fallback patterns continuously.

options.label: B
options.text: Chaos Engineering включает только Chaos Monkey (terminate instances); другие tools не существуют.

sections.what_actually: Simian Army — целый suite: Chaos Monkey (instance), Gorilla (AZ), Kong (region), Latency Monkey (latency injection), Conformity Monkey, Security Monkey, Janitor Monkey.
sections.source_of_confusion: Знание только самого известного компонента.
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix testing failures только на уровне single instance — не покрывает AZ/region failures.
sections.how_it_should_be: Layered chaos: instance (Monkey), AZ (Gorilla), region (Kong), latency, security, conformity.

options.label: C
options.text: Netflix-pioneered approach: prove resilience by deliberately injecting failures в production. Simian Army: Chaos Monkey (random instance termination, continuously in business hours), Chaos Gorilla (kill entire AZ, weekly), Chaos Kong (kill entire AWS region, monthly), Latency Monkey (inject 1-10s latency, hourly), Conformity Monkey (detect mis-configured instances, daily), Security Monkey (security violations, continuously), Janitor Monkey (orphaned resources, daily). Philosophy: «If you can't fix something, automate breaking it daily so the fix becomes mandatory». Recovery: ASG auto-spawn replicas, LB reroutes, < 30s full recovery target. Cultural: engineers expect their service to suffer → defensive code. Game days — manual chaos exercises full team. Open-source 2012, inspiration for AWS Fault Injection Simulator, Gremlin, LitmusChaos.

sections.explanation: Chaos Engineering — Netflix-pioneered approach: prove resilience system deliberately injecting failures in production. Это противоположно «safe staging-only testing» — Netflix считает что production уже имеет real failures, лучше симулировать их controllably чем ждать. Simian Army — suite инструментов на разных уровнях: Chaos Monkey (random instance termination в business hours — самый известный), Chaos Gorilla (убивает entire availability zone weekly), Chaos Kong (kills entire AWS region monthly — экстремальный test), Latency Monkey (injects 1-10s latency hourly — проверяет timeouts), Conformity Monkey (detects mis-configured instances daily), Security Monkey (security violations), Janitor Monkey (cleans orphaned resources). Philosophy: «If you can't fix something, automate breaking it daily so the fix becomes mandatory» — психологически вынуждает команды писать defensive code. Implementation: Chaos Monkey randomly picks instance from ASG, terminates с warning, monitoring measures impact, alert если impact > threshold. Recovery: ASG auto-spawns replica, LB reroutes traffic, target < 30s full recovery. Cultural impact: engineers know their service will be «harmed» — пишут defensive code, fallbacks, retries by default. Game days — manual chaos exercises с full team simulating major outages. Open-source с 2012, inspired AWS Fault Injection Simulator, Gremlin, LitmusChaos.
sections.example: Каждый день Chaos Monkey убивает несколько Recommendation Service instances — никто из 200M users не замечает потому что ASG автоматически spawns replacement, LB rerouted traffic, circuit breaker handled brief downtime.
sections.when_to_apply: Любая высоконагруженная distributed system должна делать chaos engineering; критично для multi-region active-active systems.
sections.edge_cases: Stateful services (Cassandra) требуют осторожности с chaos — потеря данных недопустима; Chaos Kong запускается только monthly с подготовкой команды.
sections.related: Q20 resilience; Q24 multi-region; Q30 no chaos антипаттерн.

options.label: D
options.text: Chaos Engineering не используется в Netflix; они полагаются только на load testing и manual incident response.

sections.what_actually: Chaos Engineering — defining innovation от Netflix. Chaos Monkey запущен в 2010, документация и open-source 2012, основа Netflix culture.
sections.source_of_confusion: Незнание Netflix history и open-source contributions.
sections.if_it_were_true: AWS Fault Injection Simulator не существовал бы; Gremlin не имел бы рыночной basis.
sections.how_it_should_be: Знать Chaos Engineering как Netflix-pioneered practice и Simian Army как suite.

blocks.question_text: Как Netflix организует multi-region active-active (US-East + EU-West + APAC) deployment?

options.label: A
options.text: Single region (только US-East) — Netflix не использует multi-region потому что AWS reliability достаточно.

sections.what_actually: Netflix multi-region active-active: US-East-1 + EU-West-1 + AP-Northeast-1 (плюс secondary). Single region не даст latency targets для EU/APAC и не выдерживает region outage.
sections.source_of_confusion: Недооценка scale и geo требований.
sections.if_it_were_true: EU/APAC users имели бы 200+ ms cross-Atlantic latency; AWS US-East outage = Netflix полностью down.
sections.how_it_should_be: Active-active multi-region с per-region full stack.

options.label: B
options.text: Multi-region active-passive: только US-East активен, EU/APAC standby и активируются только при US-East outage.

sections.what_actually: Active-passive не покрывает latency требования EU/APAC (cross-Atlantic 100+ms) и не utilize standby capacity. Netflix использует active-active.
sections.source_of_confusion: Знание DR pattern для enterprise apps вместо consumer-scale active-active.
sections.if_it_were_true: EU users имели бы плохой UX в normal operation; standby capacity простаивала.
sections.how_it_should_be: Active-active: каждый region serves local traffic с full stack.

options.label: C
options.text: Cross-region strong consistency: все writes идут через EACH_QUORUM в Cassandra, синхронно реплицируются на 3 regions.

sections.what_actually: EACH_QUORUM cross-region даёт 100+ ms latency на каждый write — неприемлемо для interactive UX. Netflix использует LOCAL_QUORUM + async replication.
sections.source_of_confusion: Желание strong consistency без понимания latency cost.
sections.if_it_were_true: Click на pause занимал бы 200ms+ из-за cross-region write — UX deterioration.
sections.how_it_should_be: LOCAL_QUORUM in-region writes + async cross-region replication, eventual consistency.

options.label: D
options.text: Active-active deployment: US-East-1 (primary US), EU-West-1 (primary EU), AP-Northeast-1 (primary APAC) + secondaries для DR. Per-region: full microservices replica + Cassandra multi-DC replication + local Eureka registry + local OCA cluster. Routing: AWS Route 53 latency-based, DNS TTL 60s для quick failover, health checks per region. Cassandra: LOCAL_QUORUM writes (latency < 10ms in-region), async replication к other regions (5-30s lag), EACH_QUORUM только для critical writes. Eventual consistency: watch progress acceptable 30s lag, profile changes — route to home region. Failover: single AZ loss → ASG другой AZ (automatic), region loss → Route 53 reroute 1-2 min, planned overcapacity 2× в survivors. Chaos Kong simulates entire region loss monthly.

sections.explanation: Netflix multi-region active-active удовлетворяет three goals: latency < 100 ms из любой geo, region outage → < 5 minutes switchover, local data residency (GDPR в EU). Primary regions: US-East-1 (N. Virginia) для US, EU-West-1 (Ireland) для EU, AP-Northeast-1 (Tokyo) для APAC, plus secondary regions per geo для disaster recovery. Per-region stack — полная replica: full microservices (catalog, recommendation, user, watch), Cassandra multi-DC replication, local Eureka registry (services discover в-region first), local OCA cluster (Open Connect). Routing: AWS Route 53 latency-based routing направляет user-а к nearest region по DNS, TTL 60 sec для quick failover, health checks per region. Cassandra multi-region: LOCAL_QUORUM writes (latency < 10 ms in-region) — большинство writes, async replication к other regions (5-30 sec lag normal), EACH_QUORUM для critical writes (slow, only при необходимости sync cross-region). Eventual consistency: watch progress eventually consistent (acceptable 30 sec lag), user profile changes — synchronous route to home region (rare operation). Failover scenarios: single AZ loss → ASG spawns в другой AZ (automatic, < 30s); region loss → Route 53 reroutes traffic to next region (1-2 minutes); cross-region disaster → regional traffic concentrates в survivors с planned overcapacity 2×. Chaos Kong simulates entire region loss monthly to verify everything works.
sections.example: Когда AWS US-East-1 имел outage 2017, Netflix Route 53 в течение 2 минут перенаправил US traffic в US-West-2, users заметили только minor delays в start playback — Continue Watching мог немного отставать.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой global service с > 10M users должен использовать multi-region active-active; latency < 100ms из любой geo нельзя достичь single region.
sections.edge_cases: GDPR требует data в EU не покидать EU — некоторые user data exclusively в EU region, иногда cross-region sync блокируется regulations.
sections.related: Q4 OCA; Q22 continue watching; Q23 Chaos Kong.

blocks.question_text: Как устроена A/B testing platform Netflix для 1000+ одновременных экспериментов?

options.label: A
options.text: Scale: Netflix runs 1000+ active experiments simultaneously. Platform: in-house experimentation infrastructure (open-sourced ABBA-like), bucketing service (consistent hashing по user_id), config service stores variants per experiment, metric pipeline collects engagement signals. Experiment design: control + 1-5 treatment variants, initial 1% traffic, ramp 5% → 25% → 50% → 100% при positive metrics, auto-rollback при regression > 1%. Metrics: primary retention D7/D30, secondary watch hours/completion/CTR, guardrail error rate + latency. Statistical: sequential testing (mSPRT) для early stopping, Bayesian inference для quick decisions, holdout 1% always для long-term effects. Pitfalls: network effects user-to-user invalidate per-user A/B → cluster-randomized для recommendation, multi-arm bandits для exploration без full A/B.

sections.explanation: Netflix runs 1000+ active experiments одновременно — каждое изменение UX, recommendation, encoding, artwork тестируется через A/B platform. Platform — in-house infrastructure (open-sourced ABBA-like для metric analysis): bucketing service использует consistent hashing по user_id для stable assignment в experiment buckets, config service хранит variants per experiment (control + treatments), metric pipeline собирает engagement signals (watch hours, retention, CTR). Experiment design: control + 1-5 treatment variants, начальная allocation 1% traffic, ramp при positive metrics 5% → 25% → 50% → 100%, auto-rollback при regression > 1% (guardrail violation). Metrics layered: primary — retention (D7, D30 returning users) — главная business metric; secondary — watch hours, completion rate, CTR; guardrail — error rate, latency, должны не деградировать ни при каких условиях. Statistical tools: sequential testing (mixture Sequential Probability Ratio Test mSPRT) для early stopping при clear winner, Bayesian inference для quick decisions с less data, holdout group 1% всегда (для long-term effects detection). Pitfalls: network effects (user-to-user interactions invalidate per-user A/B → cluster-randomized experiments для social/recommendation changes), multi-arm bandits для exploration без full A/B overhead.
sections.example: Netflix тестирует новый artwork variant для Stranger Things — 1% users получают new artwork, system measures CTR + downstream watch completion 48 hours, если winner → ramp 5% → 25% → 100% за неделю.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой product-driven company должен иметь A/B platform от ранних дней; статистика mSPRT нужна для high-throughput experiments.
sections.edge_cases: Recommendation experiments часто network-effect-prone (друг советует подруге) — нужны cluster-randomized; multi-arm bandits для cold-start titles.
sections.related: Q14 recommendation; Q16 artwork; Q30 no A/B антипаттерн.

options.label: B
options.text: Netflix не делает A/B testing — все decisions принимаются по интуиции product managers.

sections.what_actually: Netflix — pioneer data-driven product development. 1000+ active experiments одновременно (Netflix Tech Blog), каждое UX change A/B-tested.
sections.source_of_confusion: Незнание Netflix culture data-driven decisions.
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix не публиковал бы статьи про experimentation platform.
sections.how_it_should_be: Знать A/B platform как core competence Netflix.

options.label: C
options.text: Netflix запускает A/B тесты сразу на 100% traffic для быстрого результата; не использует gradual rollout.

sections.what_actually: 100% rollout без gradual ramp — антипаттерн: regression влияет на всех users сразу. Netflix uses 1% → 5% → 25% → 100% ramp с auto-rollback.
sections.source_of_confusion: Желание быстрее получить результат без понимания risk.
sections.if_it_were_true: Каждая регрессия означала бы 270M users impacted simultaneously.
sections.how_it_should_be: Gradual ramp с guardrail metrics + auto-rollback при regression.

options.label: D
options.text: A/B platform работает только для UI changes; backend изменения (encoding, recommendation) не тестируются.

sections.what_actually: Backend изменения (encoding ladder, recommendation model, ABR algorithm) — главные A/B candidates у Netflix. Каждое имеет measurable QoE impact.
sections.source_of_confusion: Узкое понимание A/B testing scope.
sections.if_it_were_true: Encoding/recommendation regressions выкатывались бы без measurement.
sections.how_it_should_be: A/B everything: UI, encoding, recommendation, ABR, infrastructure changes.

blocks.question_text: Какие компоненты включает data platform Netflix (Kafka, Iceberg, Spark, Flink) и каковы их роли?

options.label: A
options.text: Netflix использует только monolithic Hadoop кластер; Kafka/Flink/Iceberg не нужны для analytics.

sections.what_actually: Netflix модернизированный stack: Kafka (events), Flink (realtime stream processing), Spark (batch), Iceberg (data lake), Snowflake (BI). Monolithic Hadoop legacy.
sections.source_of_confusion: Знание 2010-х Big Data stack без обновления.
sections.if_it_were_true: Real-time recommendation feature updates были бы невозможны через batch-only Hadoop.
sections.how_it_should_be: Modern stream + batch + lakehouse stack.

options.label: B
options.text: Stream layer: Apache Kafka primary event backbone (trillions events/day, 100+ clusters across regions, topics watch_events/profile_changes/recommendation_clicks/errors). Stream processing: Apache Flink low-latency real-time (recommendations, fraud) с stateful processing exactly-once semantics. Batch: Apache Spark на EMR — ETL daily/hourly aggregations, ML training. Data lake: Apache Iceberg на S3 — schema evolution, time travel queries, partition pruning. Warehouse: Snowflake/Druid для BI, Tableau dashboards. Pipeline: Kafka events → Flink real-time → online features (EVCache) → Iceberg на S3 → Spark batch → ML training → models S3 → Snowflake → dashboards. Feature store: Netflix Metaflow + custom. Volume: 1 trillion events/day, 100 PB+ Iceberg, 10K+ pipelines.

sections.explanation: Netflix data platform — modern lakehouse stack с stream + batch + warehouse layers. Stream layer: Apache Kafka — primary event backbone, trillions events/day, 100+ Kafka clusters across regions для durability и locality, topics: watch_events (что smотрят, какая позиция), profile_changes (settings, preferences), recommendation_clicks, errors. Stream processing: Apache Flink — low-latency real-time processing для recommendations (online feature updates), fraud detection (anomaly detection в реальном времени), stateful processing с exactly-once semantics для accuracy. Batch processing: Apache Spark на AWS EMR — ETL daily/hourly aggregations для metrics dashboards, ML training pipelines (recommendation models retrained daily). Data lake: Apache Iceberg на S3 — modern table format с schema evolution (можно добавлять колонки without migration), time travel queries (query data as of specific timestamp), partition pruning для efficient access. Warehouse: Snowflake / Druid для BI analytics, Tableau dashboards для product teams. Full pipeline: Kafka events → Flink realtime → online features (EVCache для recommendation runtime) → Iceberg на S3 (durable storage) → Spark batch → ML training → models в S3 → Snowflake (analytics) → Tableau (dashboards). Feature store: Netflix Metaflow (open-sourced) + custom feature store для train-serve consistency (same features в training и в inference). Volume: 1 trillion events/day, 100 PB+ в Iceberg, 10K+ data pipelines.
sections.example: User click «Play» → Kafka watch_event → Flink updates online recommendation features в EVCache в реальном времени (< 1s lag) → одновременно event пишется в Iceberg для daily batch training next day.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой data-driven сервис должен иметь streaming + batch + lakehouse separation; Iceberg/Hudi/Delta — modern lakehouse standards.
sections.edge_cases: Late-arriving events требуют windowing strategies в Flink; schema evolution требует backward-compatible changes в Kafka topics и Iceberg.
sections.related: Q14 recommendation training; Q22 watch events; Q25 A/B metrics.

options.label: C
options.text: Netflix использует только Kafka — все processing (batch, streaming, ML training) через consumer groups.

sections.what_actually: Kafka — event log, не processing engine. Stream processing (Flink) и batch (Spark) нужны для compute. Storage tier (Iceberg) для durable analytical queries.
sections.source_of_confusion: Желание упростить stack до одного tool.
sections.if_it_were_true: Complex ML training joined data across days не работал бы в Kafka.
sections.how_it_should_be: Kafka (events) + Flink (stream) + Spark (batch) + Iceberg (storage) — каждый для своей задачи.

options.label: D
options.text: Все analytics в Netflix делается в Snowflake — Iceberg/Spark/Flink не используются.

sections.what_actually: Snowflake — analytical warehouse для BI/dashboards, но не подходит для 100 PB raw data lake или real-time stream processing. Netflix uses layered stack.
sections.source_of_confusion: Узкое понимание data stack как «warehouse only».
sections.if_it_were_true: Snowflake costs были бы $100M+/year для всех 100 PB.
sections.how_it_should_be: Iceberg/S3 для cheap lake storage, Spark/Flink для compute, Snowflake для BI top tier.

blocks.question_text: Как Netflix реализует downloads для offline viewing на мобильных устройствах?

options.label: A
options.text: Offline downloads не поддерживаются — Netflix только online streaming.

sections.what_actually: Netflix поддерживает offline downloads с 2016+ для mobile/tablet — это критичная feature для travel use case.
sections.source_of_confusion: Незнание Netflix mobile features.
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix терял бы пользователей которым важен offline viewing в самолёте.
sections.how_it_should_be: Знать downloads как ключевую mobile feature.

options.label: B
options.text: Downloads сохраняются как обычные video файлы без DRM — user может копировать их на другие устройства.

sections.what_actually: Studios требуют DRM для offline; downloads encrypted с persistent licenses tied to device. Free copying было бы catastrophic для licensing.
sections.source_of_confusion: Игнорирование DRM requirements от content providers.
sections.if_it_were_true: Hollywood контент моментально утекал бы в torrents.
sections.how_it_should_be: Encrypted local files + DRM persistent licenses + device binding.

options.label: C
options.text: Download = encrypted local file на device (HEVC или AV1 mobile-optimized, smaller files, lower bitrate vs streaming для battery+storage). DRM license (Widevine/FairPlay) persistent, tied to device, expiration typically 30 days after download. Storage: up to 100 episodes per device, local FS encrypted at rest. Restrictions: некоторые titles нельзя скачать (licensing limits), max downloads per account, auto-delete after expiry или watch + 48h. Sync online: watch progress saved locally → sync when reconnect → updated на сервере → Continue Watching updates (Q22). License revocation: suspended account → next online check → license invalidated → cannot play. Device limit ~5 downloaded devices per account.

sections.explanation: Offline downloads решают use case viewing без internet (самолёт, метро, плохой Wi-Fi в гостинице). Implementation: download — encrypted local file на device storage, codec mobile-optimized (HEVC или AV1 — smaller files vs H.264, better для phone/tablet battery), lower bitrate vs streaming (battery + storage savings, screen size phone не требует 4K). DRM critical: persistent license (Widevine/FairPlay в зависимости от platform) tied к device, expiration typically 30 days after download (если user не открывал app), revocable. Storage limits: up to 100 episodes per device (per user setting), local file system encrypted at rest. Restrictions: некоторые titles нельзя скачать (licensing limits — например premium новинки), max downloads per account, auto-delete after expiry или watch + 48 hours grace. Sync with online: watch progress saved locally → sync when reconnect to internet → updated на сервере в Cassandra → Continue Watching shows correct position (Q22). License revocation: suspended account → next online check (app periodically calls home) → license invalidated → playback prohibited. Device limit ~5 downloaded devices per account чтобы предотвратить sharing exploits.
sections.example: User скачивает Stranger Things S4 перед 14-часовым полётом → смотрит offline в самолёте → progress saved locally → по приземлении (Wi-Fi в аэропорту) progress sync → Continue Watching на TV дома показывает корректную позицию.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой VOD сервис с mobile clients должен поддерживать offline; для browser/desktop downloads обычно не реализуют (legal/security complexity).
sections.edge_cases: Account banned mid-flight — user продолжает смотреть пока license валиден, при следующем check license revoked; license expiry за 30 дней может frustrate долго-travel users.
sections.related: Q9 codecs; Q13 DRM; Q22 continue watching.

options.label: D
options.text: Downloads просто streaming контента в буфер; никаких offline files не сохраняется.

sections.what_actually: Это просто preloading, не downloads. Real downloads сохраняют полный episode на device storage для viewing без любого internet connectivity.
sections.source_of_confusion: Смешение buffering streaming с offline downloads.
sections.if_it_were_true: В самолёте без Wi-Fi user не мог бы ничего смотреть.
sections.how_it_should_be: Полная offline copy на device с DRM protection.

blocks.question_text: Какие основные категории cost optimization у Netflix и как Open Connect + Spot + Reserved + per-title encoding снижают затраты?

options.label: A
options.text: Netflix не оптимизирует costs — главное это product features, infrastructure costs незначительны на их revenue.

sections.what_actually: Infrastructure costs Netflix — миллиарды/год. Open Connect, per-title encoding, Spot fleet specifically инвестировано для cost reduction.
sections.source_of_confusion: Преувеличение Netflix revenue vs infrastructure cost ratio.
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix не публиковал бы статьи про Open Connect savings vs commercial CDN.
sections.how_it_should_be: Cost optimization — major engineering priority при scale.

options.label: B
options.text: Netflix полностью использует On-Demand EC2 без Reserved/Spot — flexibility important than savings.

sections.what_actually: Spot для encoding (10× saving) и Reserved для steady-state services (60% saving) — обязательные optimizations при Netflix scale. On-Demand only был бы 10× более дорогим compute.
sections.source_of_confusion: Знание базовой EC2 pricing без understanding RI/Spot.
sections.if_it_were_true: Encoding costs $250K/year вместо $25K; microservices compute $300M вместо $100M.
sections.how_it_should_be: Reserved для steady-state, Spot для batch, On-Demand только для unpredictable bursts.

options.label: C
options.text: Главная cost categorization — это только AWS EC2 instances; CDN, encoding, storage не отдельные buckets.

sections.what_actually: CDN egress — крупнейший infrastructure cost у Netflix ($300-500M/year), не EC2. Storage и encoding — отдельные categories с разными optimization patterns.
sections.source_of_confusion: Узкое понимание cost structure большого streaming.
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix не инвестировал бы в Open Connect specifically для CDN savings.
sections.how_it_should_be: Знать distribution costs: CDN (largest), compute, storage, encoding отдельно.

options.label: D
options.text: Cost buckets (annual): CDN egress $300-500M — оптимизирован Open Connect (95% traffic через OCA at ~$2/TB vs commercial CDN $20/TB = 10× cheaper, total $200-400M/year saved). AWS Compute EC2 $100-200M — Reserved + Savings Plans (3-year RI 60% discount, steady-state services как microservices/Cassandra). AWS Storage S3 $50-100M — lifecycle policies (Standard → IA after 30d unused → Glacier after 1y). Encoding $25-50M — Spot instances 90% discount (vs On-Demand). Studio licensing $15-20B — largest cost, content deals (вне infra optimization). Per-title encoding (Q8) 20-30% bitrate reduction → $50-100M/year. WebP/AVIF artwork → 30-50% smaller posters savings on CDN.

sections.explanation: Cost optimization — major engineering priority при Netflix scale. Top cost buckets (annual): CDN egress $300-500M — самая крупная инфра-категория, оптимизирована через Open Connect: 95% traffic через OCA at ~$2/TB (cost of operating OCA + ISP peering), vs commercial CDN $20/TB → 10× cheaper, total $200-400M/year saved. AWS Compute EC2 $100-200M — оптимизация через Reserved Instances и Savings Plans (3-year RI даёт 60% discount от On-Demand), используется для steady-state services (microservices, Cassandra cluster), Spot для bursty workloads (encoding). AWS Storage S3 $50-100M — lifecycle policies автоматически перемещают данные: Standard → IA (Infrequent Access) after 30 days unused → Glacier after 1 year unused, спасает миллионы. Encoding $25-50M — Spot instances 90% discount vs On-Demand (Q10), embarrassingly parallel workload идеален для Spot. Studio licensing $15-20B — самый большой cost overall (Hollywood content deals), вне infrastructure optimization но shapes everything else. Per-title encoding (Q8) даёт 20-30% bitrate reduction → equivalent CDN savings $50-100M/year. Image optimization: WebP/AVIF artwork → 30-50% smaller posters vs JPEG, savings on CDN bandwidth для homepage assets. Trade-offs: aggressive Spot use → orchestration complexity, Reserved Instances commitment → less flexibility, Open Connect requires ISP relationships (years to build).
sections.example: На пике трафика Open Connect serves ~950 Gbps на крупном ISP за <$2K/day infrastructure cost; commercial CDN тарифицировал бы то же в $20K+/day. На годовом масштабе разница составляет $200M+ savings.
sections.when_to_apply: Любой консумерский сервис на petascale должен оптимизировать CDN/compute/storage; small-scale costs обычно dominated by people, не infrastructure.
sections.edge_cases: Spot price spikes требуют fallback на On-Demand для critical encoding; Reserved Instances commitment иногда лишний если traffic растёт нелинейно.
sections.related: Q4 OCA; Q8 per-title; Q10 Spot; Q30 antipatterns.

blocks.question_text: Как Netflix детектирует и обрабатывает account/password sharing (crackdown 2023)?

options.label: A
options.text: Detection через household graph: ML model identifies «household» = devices that watch in same home Wi-Fi periodically. Outside-household streams trigger verification. Signals: device locations (IP, geo, ISP), login patterns (time-of-day, frequency), watch patterns (simultaneous streams на 3+ different IP ranges), device fingerprints (unique IDs across logins). Enforcement: friction (не block) — user prompted to verify primary location, soft warnings before hard block, adoption of «Extra Member» subscription ($7.99/month). Edge cases: traveling household member — temporary access allowed, student dormitory flexibility, different time-zones accommodation. Crackdown 2023 increased Extra Member adoption, billions $$ revenue.

sections.explanation: Account sharing был массовым (по оценкам 100M+ households sharing) и стоил Netflix billions/year потерянного revenue. 2023 crackdown stricter «Primary household» detection + Extra members $7.99/month. Detection signals: device locations — IP addresses, geo-location, ISP (sharing across countries vs same neighborhood); login patterns — time-of-day, frequency, simultaneous logins; watch patterns — simultaneous streams на 3+ different IP ranges (один user не может быть в трёх городах сразу); device fingerprints — unique device IDs across logins (через browser fingerprinting, device cookies, hardware identifiers). Algorithm: «Household» определяется как devices that watch in same home Wi-Fi periodically (clusters в graph). ML model identifies household graph (devices clusters по spatial + temporal patterns). Outside-household streams trigger verification challenge. Enforcement: graduated (friction не block) — user prompted to verify primary location (email confirmation, в-app), soft warnings before hard block, adoption of «Extra Member» $7.99/month subscription как legalization sharing. Edge cases: traveling household member (vacation, business trip) — temporary access allowed by IP+time signals; student dormitory (away from home часть года) — flexibility per university calendar; different time-zones — accommodate (например family международная). Other fraud types: stolen credit cards (fraud signals on signup), subscription fraud free-trial abuse (device fingerprint blocklist), bot accounts (rate limiting + CAPTCHA).
sections.example: User в Лондоне streaming с двух IP в Нью-Йорке одновременно — flagged as cross-household sharing → verification challenge → option upgrade на Extra Member.
sections.when_to_apply: Subscription services с per-user pricing должны иметь sharing detection; UGC/free services без аналогичной проблемы.
sections.edge_cases: VPN users могут получать false positives (IP looks remote); business travelers с frequent geo changes требуют ML adjustment.
sections.related: Q14 user signals; Q24 multi-region IPs.

options.label: B
options.text: Netflix не отслеживает account sharing — share свободно с кем угодно без последствий.

sections.what_actually: С 2023 Netflix активно борется с account sharing (crackdown announcement). Detection и enforcement через ML household graph.
sections.source_of_confusion: Игнорирование 2023 anti-sharing initiative.
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix не разработал бы «Extra Member» subscription и не получал бы billions $$ дополнительного revenue.
sections.how_it_should_be: Знать про 2023 crackdown и household graph detection.

options.label: C
options.text: Detection основан только на IP address: разные IP = разные households, automatic block.

sections.what_actually: Pure IP-based detection даёт false positives (mobile users часто меняют IP — Wi-Fi → 4G → coffee shop). Netflix использует multi-signal ML model.
sections.source_of_confusion: Упрощение detection до single signal.
sections.if_it_were_true: Mobile users получали бы постоянные verification challenges → массовый churn.
sections.how_it_should_be: Multi-signal: IP + geo + device fingerprint + watch pattern + temporal.

options.label: D
options.text: Detected sharing immediately blocks account без any warning или friction.

sections.what_actually: Netflix uses graduated enforcement: friction (verification challenge) → soft warnings → Extra Member offer → hard block только в крайнем случае. Immediate block убил бы PR.
sections.source_of_confusion: Желание агрессивного enforcement без понимания UX implications.
sections.if_it_were_true: Massive PR fallout, churn спайки, customer complaints в массе.
sections.how_it_should_be: Graduated approach: verify → warn → upsell Extra Member → block if needed.

blocks.question_text: Какой набор антипаттернов и подводных камней в архитектуре Netflix-style streaming наиболее критичен?

options.label: A
options.text: Главный антипаттерн — использование микросервисов вместо monolith; нужен один сервис на всё.

sections.what_actually: Микросервисы — pioneered Netflix specifically для resilience и independent deploy. Монолит на consumer scale = single point of failure и невозможность independent scaling.
sections.source_of_confusion: Anti-microservices hype без понимания scale realities.
sections.if_it_were_true: Netflix не открывал бы Eureka/Zuul/Hystrix; один deploy ломал бы весь сервис.
sections.how_it_should_be: Microservices правильные для consumer-scale + chaos engineering для proof.

options.label: B
options.text: (1) Synchronous calls между всеми сервисами — cascade failures, slow downstream blocks upstream → fix через async (Kafka events для side effects), tight timeouts, bulkheads. (2) Single CDN provider без fallback → multi-CDN. (3) No chaos testing → Chaos Monkey + monthly Kong drills. (4) Strong consistency между regions → eventual + LOCAL_QUORUM. (5) Каждый сервис без circuit breaker → Resilience4j всех external calls. (6) Sync click counter updates → async через Kafka aggregation. (7) Без A/B platform → experimentation от day 1. (8) Fixed bitrate ladder для всего content → per-title encoding 20% saving. (9) One codec для всех devices → device-aware AV1→HEVC→VP9→H.264. (10) No DRM → Widevine/FairPlay/PlayReady. (11) Pure pull-based CDN → pre-positioning overnight. (12) Без observability на QoE → composite QoE metric + alert. (13) Encoding на On-Demand EC2 → Spot fleet 10× cheaper. (14) Monolith service → microservices independent deploy. (15) Без forensic watermarking → per-user watermark.

sections.explanation: Главные антипаттерны и подводные камни Netflix-style streaming собраны из реального опыта эволюции архитектуры. (1) Sync calls cascade — microservice A → B sync → C sync, A waits whole chain; C slow → B threads blocked → A threads blocked, fix через async Kafka events + tight timeouts + bulkheads. (2) Single CDN provider — outage = 0 revenue, fix multi-CDN (Open Connect + commercial fallback). (3) No chaos testing — untested failover работает only ~40% времени, fix Chaos Monkey continuous + monthly Kong drills. (4) Strong cross-region consistency — cross-region sync writes 100+ ms latency, fix eventual consistency + LOCAL_QUORUM. (5) No circuit breaker — slow downstream cascades, fix Resilience4j всех external calls. (6) Sync click counter — hot title spike → row contention, fix async через Kafka aggregation. (7) No A/B platform — rollout без measurement = guessing, fix experimentation from day 1. (8) Fixed bitrate ladder — cartoon over-encoded action under-encoded, fix per-title encoding 20% bandwidth saving. (9) One codec — H.264 only = 30% extra bandwidth vs AV1, fix device-aware codec ladder. (10) No DRM — studios refuse to license, fix Widevine/FairPlay/PlayReady. (11) Pull-based CDN only — cold cache spike at premiere, fix pre-positioning overnight. (12) No QoE observability — metrics ok but rebuffering high, fix composite QoE metric + alert on degradation. (13) On-Demand EC2 encoding — 10× over Spot cost. (14) Monolith service — один deploy ломает всё, fix microservices independent deploy. (15) No forensic watermarking — leaked content untraceable, fix per-user embedded watermark.
sections.example: Netflix испытывает каждый из этих антипаттернов на собственном опыте до решения — Chaos Monkey появился именно потому что они увидели «untested failover не работает в реальности», Hystrix/Resilience4j из cascade incidents 2010-х.

sections.edge_cases: Не все patterns обязательны на small scale — microservices overhead больше pays off > 10M users, chaos engineering требует mature ops culture.
